description: session-objective 3.0: one objective file per session, split four ways, and four checkpoints the agent cannot walk past. [UserPromptSubmit] append the operator's message to the append-only ledger verbatim, then rewrite the OBJECTIVE and the WORKFLOW with an interpreter call whose only input is that ledger — no doctrine, no project, no session — and inject them with the one derived CURRENT CHECKPOINT line || [PreToolUse, every tool] deny any write whose result changes a byte of the LEDGER, the OBJECTIVE or the WORKFLOW; deny every Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and apply_patch under the session cwd until a C1 proof is on disk; run a checkpoint proof the moment it is recorded and refuse the write unless it reproduces; keep recorded checkpoint proofs append-only; allow a Read of this session's own objective file || [Stop] refuse to end a turn while STATUS is ACTIVE, naming the current checkpoint (bounded at 3), refuse a WAITING with nothing in flight, refuse a NEEDS-DECISION whose question was never asked, and refuse a COMPLETE whose C1, C2 or D-item proofs do not reproduce, whose transcript shows no fresh verifier answering PASS after the last product write, or whose objective still lags the ledger || [SessionStart] re-inject on startup, resume and compact; archive and start empty on clear || [SubagentStart] seed the subagent's own file from the parent's OBJECTIVE and WORKFLOW layers with an empty ledger
